newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian government orders household gas price hike.
newsitem.headline: Russian government orders household gas price hike.

text.p: The Russian government has ordered natural gas prices for household consumers be raised in stages, Interfax news agency reported on Tuesday.

It quoted a government order as saying wholesale prices of natural gas intended for resale to households should be raised by January 1, 1999, to the level of wholesale prices, before tax, on gas intended for industrial consumers sold to resellers.
Consumer utility prices are generally lower than industrial prices, an unusual but politically popular situation in Russia. The situation has been criticised for slowing industrial growth.

The wholesale rates for household-destination gas will be raised to 65 percent of industrial-destination wholesale prices from October 1, 1997, and 80 percent from April 1, 1998. The final rise to 100 percent will be on January 1, 1999, it said.
